topic: Chapter 1194: Zoro uses Sommers' regeneration as a sparring partner to learn Conqueror's Haki
title: Zoro Treated A Knight Of God Like Training (1194)
description: In One Piece chapter 1194 Zoro keeps cutting Saint Sommers to test his Haki. Here's why a regenerating Knight of God might be the perfect sparring partner, and how Mihawk's old lesson fits. Did Zoro just finish his training?
comment: Zoro or Luffy: who lands the final blow on Imu?

lines.text: Zoro treated a Knight of God like a training dummy.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman facing a giant armored knight

lines.text: In chapter 1193 he works out that only a Supreme King Haki strike to the steel heart kills one.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with three swords, dark aura, anime style

lines.text: So in 1194 you'd expect him to rush the kill.
He doesn't. He cuts Sommers' limbs off, Sommers regenerates, and Zoro keeps testing.
Is my Haki in the blade this time? No? Again.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with three swords, dark aura, anime style

lines.text: Sommers even mocks him, because he can tell Zoro hasn't mastered it yet.
People say that's Zoro being reckless. But a regenerating enemy is the perfect sparring partner.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with three swords, dark aura, anime style

lines.text: Remember Mihawk's old lesson: Conqueror's Haki is sensing your own strength.

shot.fallback: hawk eyed swordsman teaching a young swordsman

lines.text: Here's my read. Zoro needed a target that wouldn't stay broken.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with three swords, dark aura, anime style

lines.text: Then he coats all three swords in dark flames and black lightning, and the regeneration stops.

shot.fallback: three swords wrapped in black lightning

lines.text: Zoro didn't win a fight. He finished a lesson.

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman with three swords, dark aura, anime style

lines.text: Because Zoro treated a Knight of God like a training dummy...

shot.fallback: green haired swordsman facing a giant armored knight
